Can you lend me a hand with that? You help me, I help you, like brother to brother! Finding fairs is easy - just follow wherever you see the most holiday lights.}} ==Objectives== * Locate and visit the Christmas tree on [[Lighthouse]] * Locate and visit the Christmas tree on [[Customs]] * Locate and visit the Christmas tree on [[Reserve]] * Locate and visit the Christmas tree on [[Interchange]] * Locate and visit the Christmas tree on [[Shoreline]] * Locate and visit the Christmas tree on [[Woods]] ==Rewards== * +7,000 [[EXP]] * [[Ragman]] Rep '''+0.01''' * 65,000 Roubles ** 68,250 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence center]] Level 1 ** 74,750 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence center]] Level 2 * 2× [[Peltor ComTac V headset (OD Green)]] {{quote|Nice job! Here, you'll need this.}} ==Guide== In this quest you have to find the Christmas trees on the specified maps.
